name: Simple ActiveCampaign Membership DigitalME
author: DigitalME

sections.description:
This lightweight plugin lets you control the visibility of specific pages based on a visitor’s ActiveCampaign tag.

Whether you’re building a membership site, offering gated content, or customizing user experiences, this plugin gives you precise control over who sees what — using the power of ActiveCampaign tag.

Simply choose one tag, and decide whether users with (or without) those tag can view a particular page.
